title: Join us on Friday, July 30th, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
summary: Hear about the construction and usage of the Human Reference Atlas developed in HuBMAP & SenNet.
bodyHtml:
🧬 Hear about the construction and usage of the Human Reference Atlas developed in HuBMAP & SenNet.

📆 July 30th, 2026

⏰ 1-2 PM ET

🎙️ Speakers:

  • Katy Borner, PhD–Lead of the Human Reference Atlas (HRA)
  • Andreas Bueckle, PhD–NIH HuBMAP JumpStart Fellow
  • Daniel Bolin–Sr. Software developer for the Human Reference Atlas (HRA)

🔗 Explore https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02563-5 and HRA Portal at https://humanatlas.io.
